इरिका N. of a plant or tree.
˚वनं a grove of such trees.

.
--2 Hence,
a bare or barren soil, desert, dreary
region.
--3 Non-support.
--4 A rivulet,
well (Ved.).
--5 A hollow, hole.

इरिण्य a. Belonging or relating
to a desert.

Instigating.
--2
Powerful, violent.
--3 A proud or
overbearing fellow.

इरिविल्ला or इरिविल्लिका Pimples
on the head.

ईरित p. p.
1 Sent, despatched.
--2
Said, uttered &c.; ˚आकूतं declared
purpose or intention.

ईरिण a. [ईर्-इनन्] Desert,
barren.
--णं A desert, barren soil;
मुहूर्तमिव निःशब्दमासीदीरिणसंनिभं Rām.
